service-call.in-map: {baseOrderId:(baseOrderId || null), orderId:(sourceOrderId || null), recurRevision:(recurRevision || null), frequency:(frequency || null), dayOfMonth:(dayOfMonth || null), dayOfWeek:(dayOfWeek || null), month:(month || null), hourOfDay:(hourOfDay ?? null), recurCronExpression:(recurCronExpression || null), recurTimeZone:(recurTimeZone || null), recurFromDate:(recurFromDate || null), recurThruDate:(recurThruDate || null), recurAgreementId:(recurAgreementId ?? null), recurAutoInvoice:(recurAutoInvoice || 'N'), reason:(reason || null)}

if.message: ${stored.created ? 'Recurring order ' + stored.baseOrderId + ' started' : 'Recurrence saved'}${stored.nextText ? ' · next order ' + stored.nextText : ''}

service-call.name: mantle.order.SalesRecurrenceServices.change#SalesRecurrence
service-call.in-map: {baseOrderId:baseOrderId, recurRevision:recurRevision, operation:operation, reason:(reason || null), endDate:(endDate || null), operationKey:(operationKey || null)}

if.message: ${changed.operation == 'retry' ? 'Order ' + changed.orderId + ' made' : changed.operation == 'pause' ? 'Recurrence paused' : changed.operation == 'resume' ? 'Recurrence resumed' : 'Recurrence ended'}
